title: STAIR: Effective Incident Response Using an End-to-End Agentic Planning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.09524v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Incident response planning is critical for restoring compromised software systems. Existing AIOps methods automate fault diagnosis and remediation and adapt response using feedback, but lack a unified decision basis across planning and execution. This limits their ability to maintain incident state and align actions with evolving recovery objectives during long-horizon, multi-stage security incident response. We present STAIR, an end-to-end agentic response framework that organizes planning and execution around a shared incident state. STAIR maintains incident evidence, response actions, and execution feedback in Graph-as-State (GAS), using the latest state to determine the response stage and recovery objectives for stage-specialized planning. translated_title: STAIR：使用端到端智能体规划框架实现有效的事件响应
translated_abstract: 事件响应规划对于恢复受损的软件系统至关重要。现有的AIOps方法能够自动化故障诊断与修复，并利用反馈来调整响应，但在规划与执行之间缺乏统一的决策依据。这限制了它们在长时间跨度、多阶段的安全事件响应过程中维持事件状态并使行动与不断变化的恢复目标保持一致的能力。我们提出了STAIR，这是一个端到端的智能体响应框架，它围绕共享的事件状态来组织规划与执行。STAIR在Graph-as-State（GAS）中维护事件证据、响应动作和执行反馈，并利用最新状态来确定响应阶段以及面向阶段专项规划的恢复目标。该框架基于当前状态和阶段检索经过效果验证的历史经验，以指导动作选择。执行工具负责执行动作并将反馈返回给……
tldr: STAIR提出了一个围绕Graph-as-State共享事件状态组织的端到端智能体响应框架，通过统一的决策依据在长时间跨度的多阶段安全事件响应中有效维持事件状态并对齐不断演进的恢复目标。
en_tdlr: STAIR is an end-to-end agentic response framework that organizes planning and execution around a shared Graph-as-State incident state, enabling unified decision-making to maintain incident state and align actions with evolving recovery objectives in long-horizon, multi-stage security incident response.
